payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited background, considered as a whole, read as a recognizable basketball court rather than basketball equipment and limited floor markings against a predominantly non-court backdrop?
node.criteria: Pass if the visible background as a whole reads as a basketball court, with recognizable court setting evidence; fail if basketball-related equipment or limited markings are present but the background does not read as a court; unknown if the background cannot be assessed.
node.binding: Assess the edited background as a whole in context of the requested background replacement. Distinguish the overall court setting from a hoop, basketballs, or isolated lines alone. Do not require any particular court feature beyond a recognizable basketball-court background. A fail does not erase basketball-related progress evidenced by other supports; use unknown only when visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely unclear.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image shows a basketball playing surface in the background, with court markings visible behind the subject.
The edited background visibly includes a basketball hoop and net, basketballs, and court floor markings, which are recognizable basketball-court features.
